# Replication Paper (ICSE SEET 2027)

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| **Page limit** | Max **5 pages**, plus **1 page of references** (strict; violations are desk-rejected) |
| **Definition** | Describes the repetition of an existing, already-published **pedagogical intervention** (e.g., course, approach, study) in **new contexts**. Goal: determine whether the basic findings of the original intervention hold in other contexts. |
| **Evaluation criteria** | Relevance, Significance, Soundness, Presentation (see [criterion definitions](../../evaluation-criteria)) |
